explanation: With unequal masses accelerations differ 20x. The engine splits dt into substeps when bodies accelerate strongly (step 1 used 11 substeps). If substep count is chosen per-body, the heavy/low-accel body and light/high-accel body integrate with different force-evaluation histories, breaking Newton's third-law symmetry and injecting net momentum (0 initial -> ~0.246 at step 1). Equal masses give identical substep histories so symmetry is restored and the rule passes. Persistence at dt=0.001 shows it is not just coarse dt.
